title: Campaign directory and Draft preparation
question: Choose the composition for the campaign directory, saved Draft, and opening review.

options.label: Preparation sheet
options.thesis: One continuous sheet moves from campaign details through roster and teams to the opening checkpoint.
options.viewport: A wide preparation sheet holds numbered sections and a full-width opening review at its foot.
options.risk: The final commitment sits lower on long preparation pages.

options.label: Details and readiness
options.thesis: Preparation fills the main column while a narrow readiness board keeps the opening consequence in view.
options.viewport: A broad details and teams column sits beside a compact roster and opening board.
options.risk: The two columns must collapse carefully on phones.

options.label: Opening checkpoint
options.thesis: The enrollment consequence leads the page, with editable preparation sections directly beneath it.
options.viewport: A wide opening review leads above compact campaign details and durable-team rows.
options.risk: An early opening action needs especially clear blocker and warning states.
